camel_example: aliyun dts SuspendDtsJob --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --ZeroEtlJob true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
description_en: Suspends a data migration or synchronization task. Change tracking tasks are not supported. Change tracking instances do not support the suspend capability. Do not call this operation on change tracking instances
description_zh: 调用SuspendDtsJob暂停一个数据迁移或同步任务。不支持数据订阅任务，数据订阅实例当前不提供暂停能力，请勿对数据订阅实例调用该接口
kebab_example: aliyun dts suspend-dts-job --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-instance-id dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SuspendDtsJob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking task.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh:
迁移、同步或订阅任务ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The migration, synchronization, or subscribe instance ID
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

The default value is Forward.
You can set this parameter to Reverse to suspend the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：

Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
当数据同步实例的拓扑为双向时，才可以传入Reverse以暂停反向同步链路
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:

false: no.
true: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：

false：否。
true：是
parameters.name: zero_etl_job
